articles.title: Philadelphia Museum Closure Prompts Funding Offer and Planned City Hearings
articles.summary: The Academy of Natural Sciences Museum has closed after nearly two centuries of public visits. Supporters seek reopening, and Philadelphia's city council plans hearings into the decision.

articles.title: Robotaxi Cameras Put Passenger Privacy Under Scrutiny
articles.summary: Waymo, Zoox and Tesla describe safety and service uses for cameras inside driverless taxis. Experts want clearer limits on how passenger information can be collected and used.

articles.title: At 91, Dale Sanders Reclaims Appalachian Trail Age Record
articles.summary: Dale Sanders completed the Appalachian Trail in 359 days, becoming its oldest finisher at 91. He hiked separate sections and took a winter break.
